max_hops.description: Block when traced exposure is at or within this many hops. 3 blocks any exposure the screening can find, 2 lets a three-hop wallet through, 1 blocks only direct dealings, 0 blocks only known Lazarus addresses themselves.

min_exposure_usd.description: Block only when the exposure is worth at least this much. Exposure value is the smallest transfer along the path, so a large receipt downstream of a trivial one counts as trivial. Set to 0 to block on any traced exposure regardless of size. Does not apply to a wallet that is itself a known Lazarus address, which is always denied.
